title: Saudi Arabian Frittata
description: A classic frittata recipe from the Arabian Peninsula, made with eggs and a blend of spices. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the frittata cheese and cook until melted and lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, black pepper, and paprika (if using).
Pour the egg mixture over the melted cheese in the skillet.
Cook until the eggs are almost set, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, until the eggs are fully set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
